title: Cells with Odd Values in a Matrix
summary: Given an m x n matrix initialized to all 0's and a 2D array of indices, for each index in the array, increment all cells in the specified row and all cells in the specified column.
statement: Given an m x n matrix initialized to all 0's and a 2D array of indices, for each index in the array, increment all cells in the specified row and all cells in the specified column. After applying the increments for all given indices, return the count of cells that have odd values.
constraints: Each operation increments one whole row and one whole column.
Return the number of cells with odd final values.
hints: Only row and column increment parity matters.
Toggle a bit for each referenced row and column.
A cell is odd exactly when its row and column bits differ.
Its value is row increments plus column increments, whose parity is XOR.
editorial: Its value is row increments plus column increments, whose parity is XOR.

tests.explanation: Both rows are toggled once while column one is toggled twice, so all six cells are odd.
Each row and column is toggled once, so every cell receives an even total and the answer is zero.
